restaurant_name: GreenCross Medical Clinic ไนท์บาซ่า คลินิก
text:
Fell ill with gastroenteritis during my trip and sought treatment at the clinic. Dr Chartchai was very patient and thorough, and explained the treatment options in English. Fortunately the clinic was equipped with beds for IV fluid therapy (for dehydration). Stayed there for about 2 hours for the treatment. Doctor was attentive and also very kind. He gave me a lift back to my hotel (about 10 mins away) after the treatment.

I was well enough to fly out the next day, and recovered fully after 3 days. Very thankful to Dr Chartchai for his expertise and kindness.

Things to note:
The clinic has only been opened for 3 months (when I visited) so it's a one-man show for now. The nearest toilet is up a flight of stairs outside the clinic (FYI).

5/5 the best experience I have ever had at any medical office or hospital in my life.

His english is great and any concern I had about language barrier disappeared within moments of meeting him and he is very kind. I had to receive multiple injections in the muscle and he was very gentle.

I was very impressed with the service at this clinic. From the moment I stepped in, the staff were welcoming, polite, and explained the procedures clearly. The clinic was clean and organized, and the wait time was short.

The doctor provided detailed advice, examined me attentively, and explained my symptoms and treatment plan in an easy-to-understand way. They weren't rushed, which made me feel comfortable and confident in the treatment.
